9245  004054  %        READ RT-DESCRIPTION BITMAP WORDS, FOUND FROM ADDRESS X+25.
9246  004054  %        CLEAR PAGE-TABLE ENTRIES CORRESPONDING TO 1-BITS IN BITMAP.
